briefdescription.para: Records edit counts, and stages the file when its planned bytes differ from its original bytes.

detaileddescription.para: The edit count is added to the total even when the bytes do not change. The file is staged only when the planned bytes differ from the original bytes.

parameterdescription.para: Pre-edit document snapshot; must not be null.
Line-level changes to apply onto originalDocument. The diff holds the planned bytes, which the staged file writes at commit.
Logical edit count added to the --expect total.

simplesect.para: Ok when the file is staged or needs no change. Otherwise the failure that Writer::getWriteStatus reports, such as a hard-linked or read-only file.

briefdescription.para: Runs the transaction: a checked dry run, or a commit with --apply.

detaileddescription.para: Without --apply, the command prints the unified diff of each staged file and writes nothing. When --expect is given, it must match the total edit count first. A mismatch prints the diff, reports both counts, and exits with exitMismatch. Nothing is written, and no commit runs.

parameterdescription.para: The parsed arguments of the command.

simplesect.para: The exit code, the output documents, and the failures.

briefdescription.para: Reads the --expect count from the arguments, and checks it against --apply.

detaileddescription.para: --apply requires --expect. The count is 0 when --expect is absent.

simplesect.para: Status result paired with the expected edit count.

param.type: const std::function< std::pair< juce::Result, bool >(const StagedFile &)> &

briefdescription.para: Calls a function for each staged file in order, and restores the files before a failure.

detaileddescription.para: The loop stops at the first failure. The files before the failure are restored. The failing file is restored too when its call reports true. A restore that fails does not stop the other restores.

parameterdescription.para: The staged files, in transaction order.
The transaction whose blob files the restore reads.
The operation for one staged file. Its bool is true when the target may have changed.

simplesect.para: Tuple of: the failure, or ok; the display path of the file that failed; and the display paths that could not be restored. The path is empty and the list is empty when every call succeeds.

briefdescription.para: Stages the blobs and the record, writes the planned files, and publishes the record.

detaileddescription.para: The id is returned as soon as the files are written, even when the publish fails. This lets the caller report the id, so the user can undo the written files.

simplesect.para: Status result paired with the transaction id. The id is empty when staging or writing failed.
